subject: math
name: Mathematics
title: Grade 6 Mathematics: Ratios, Rational Numbers & Expressions
overview: Grade 6 Mathematics advances algebraic reasoning, proportional problem solving, geometric modeling, and statistical inference preparing students for rigorous high school pathways.
competencies: Analyze proportional relationships, rate models, and linear equations in real-world contexts.
Perform operations fluently with rational numbers, exponents, and algebraic expressions.
Apply geometric principles, coordinate transformations, and measurement formulas.
Collect, summarize, and evaluate statistical distributions and probability models.

modules.title: Ratios and Unit Rates
modules.description: Developing understanding of ratio relationships, unit rates, solving rate problems with tables, tape diagrams, and double number lines.

topics.title: Representing and Reasoning About Ratios
topics.description: Using tape diagrams and ratio tables to compare quantities and solve part-to-part and part-to-whole problems.

topics.title: Unit Rates and Rate Tables
topics.description: Calculating unit rates (cost per item, miles per hour) and converting measurement units.

topics.title: Percentages as Rates per 100
topics.description: Finding the percent of a quantity and solving real-world percentage discount and tax problems.

modules.title: Arithmetic Operations Including Division of Fractions
modules.description: Dividing fractions by fractions using visual models, fluently dividing multi-digit numbers, and operating on decimals.

topics.title: Division of Fractions by Fractions
topics.description: Interpreting division of fractions using strip diagrams and reciprocal multiplication algorithm.

topics.title: Multi-Digit Division and Decimal Fluency
topics.description: Mastering long division algorithm and executing all four operations with decimals fluently.

topics.title: Greatest Common Factor and Least Common Multiple
topics.description: Finding GCF and LCM using prime factorization and the distributive property.

modules.title: Rational Numbers and the Coordinate Plane
modules.description: Extending the number line to negative integers, ordering rational numbers, absolute value, and all four quadrants of the coordinate plane.

topics.title: Positive and Negative Numbers on the Number Line
topics.description: Using signed numbers to represent real-world quantities (temperature, elevation, debits).

topics.title: Absolute Value and Ordering Rational Numbers
topics.description: Understanding absolute value as distance from zero and writing inequality statements.

topics.title: The Four-Quadrant Coordinate Plane
topics.description: Plotting coordinate pairs in all four quadrants, reflecting points, and calculating polygon perimeter/area.

modules.title: Expressions and Equations
modules.description: Writing, reading, and evaluating algebraic expressions with exponents, solving one-variable one-step equations and inequalities.

topics.title: Whole Number Exponents and Algebraic Expressions
topics.description: Writing and evaluating numerical expressions with whole number exponents and variable terms.

topics.title: Equivalent Expressions and the Distributive Property
topics.description: Applying commutative, associative, and distributive properties to generate equivalent expressions.

topics.title: Solving One-Step Equations and Graphing Inequalities
topics.description: Using inverse operations to solve x + p = q and px = q, and graphing x > c on number lines.
